issue_request: FHIR-13371 was Published / Persuasive for STU3 and requested a token search parameter allowing search by DocumentReference.content.attachment.contentType, described as mimeType/contentType.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by commit 94e532a611, which explicitly listed GF#13371 in a San Diego WGM block-vote commit and added a contenttype token search-parameter row over DocumentReference.content.attachment.contentType to the historical DocumentReference spreadsheet source. Later source rework moved the active current definition into source/documentreference/bundle-DocumentReference-search-params.xml.
additional_context: DocumentReference is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini, now assigned to OO. The active search-parameter bundle defines DocumentReference-contenttype with code contenttype, type token, and expression/path DocumentReference.content.attachment.contentType. A directly related 2016 Zulip thread supports the contentType/contenttype search-parameter use case and naming style. FHIR-53215 later included DocumentReference-contenttype in broader R6 normative ballot-prep status work, but did not change the parameter expression required by this issue. Confluence searches found no conflicting work-group record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the authoritative current source already implements FHIR-13371.
